mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% month-over-month (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates labor market weakness despite job gains, signaling an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE and PAYEMS rise (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During housing market booms (HOUST > 650 thousand units), robust consumer spending and business investment drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 650 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates for future cash flows, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending, reducing corporate revenues and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls below 400000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls and CPIAUCSL rises (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
